text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CLOSE; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; STARS GET NO PASS
sees: A stern older gray-haired man with glasses in a navy suit stands facing front, mouth flat. Large headline text overlaps the top of his head, with PASS highlighted in a pink box. Striped beige background.
message: Even your top performers do not get a free pass from standards.
wouldConfuse: Headline overlaps his head; 'pass' could be read as passing a test or a ball.

text: INSIGHT 03 / 08 DEVELOPMENT; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; 5 MINUTES NOW; 50 INTERRUPTIONS LATER
sees: A diagram of two circles joined by a line with an orange dot between them. The left circle says 5 MINUTES NOW, the right orange circle is empty with the label 50 INTERRUPTIONS LATER. Faint window and desk in the background, no people.
message: Spending five minutes helping someone now saves you from fifty interruptions later.
wouldConfuse: The right circle is empty, and the label sits below it, so the pairing is slightly unclear.

text: INSIGHT 07 / 08 CLOSE; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; CAPABLE, MADE A MISTAKE
sees: A young man with glasses and a dark hoodie tilts slightly with a worried, uncertain frown. Large headline over an orange sunburst background with window and desk silhouettes. MISTAKE is highlighted.
message: A capable person made a mistake, and that is how it should be treated.
wouldConfuse: Headline overlaps his hair.

text: INSIGHT 08 / 08 CLOSE; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; COMPLETELY BACKWARD
sees: An empty office room: two windows, a desk with two mugs, sunburst rays on a beige background. The headline sits at the bottom. No people.
message: The usual way of doing it is completely backward.
wouldConfuse: No visual supports the words, so the subject is unclear.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 TURN; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; HIDE THEIR MISTAKES
sees: On the left a worried young man with brown hair and a bag holds a notepad. On the right a huge black mask with white eyes and an orange smile and orange side lines. Headline top left with MISTAKES highlighted.
message: People hide their mistakes behind a smiling mask.
wouldConfuse: The mask could read as a villain or theater instead of concealment.

text: INSIGHT 04 / 08 TURN; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; TOO AFRAID TO TRY
sees: A young man with brown hair and a bag strap looks sideways with an eye-roll or uneasy look and flat mouth. Orange sunburst background and a lamp. Big headline on the right.
message: Employees are too afraid to try anything new.
wouldConfuse: His face looks bored or annoyed more than afraid.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; EVERYONE WOULD GET 100% (all struck through)
sees: An angry gray-haired man in glasses and a suit points sharply to the right, scowling. Next to him, the headline has every word crossed out with orange lines.
message: It is not true that everyone would get 100 percent; that idea is rejected.
wouldConfuse: The strikethrough could mean the manager scolding people or the claim being denied.

text: INSIGHT 01 / 08 SETUP; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; I HAVE A PROBLEM

wouldConfuse: The phone suggests a call rather than a conversation at a desk.

sees: An older man in a suit and a young man with a bag stand side by side, both blank-faced. A giant clock with an orange minute hand dominates the right. Headline top left.
message: The boss says he will let the issue slide as time passes.
wouldConfuse: The clock could suggest deadlines or lateness.

text: INSIGHT 05 / 08 CONSEQUENCE; THE NEW ONE MINUTE MANAGER; NEW OR PROMOTED

wouldConfuse: None

sees: A smiling gray-haired man with glasses in a suit holds a small notepad. Headline to the right with ALL highlighted. Peach sunburst background.

wouldConfuse: None
